items.title: Chink Martin Interview, 1966-10-19
items.q: Freddie Newman was our piano player when we played at the ringside for Pete Whippen.

ctx.x: Well when I was with Detroit, Freddie Newman was playing. Freddie Newman was the piano player with Detroit when I played with Detroit. Freddie Newman, yeah. Yeah, you played with Freddie Newman at the Bienville Roof, didn't you? Yeah.

Oh, I played with Freddie Newman plenty of times. I played with Freddie Newman. Freddie Newman was our piano player when we played at the ringside for Pete Whippen. And then when we played for, what is his name, I can't think of his name, he had a nightclub on Bienville Street.
Oh, hell, what is his name? Musician-only club?
